description: Ranked full-text search over vendor, model, aliases and identifiers across curated records and imported databases (OpenWrt, Zigbee2MQTT, Tasmota...). Use it to explore ("all DJI drones", "open-firmware cameras") or when lookup_device finds nothing and you suspect another name. Each result has an id to pass to lookup_device.

query.description: Words to match: vendor, model, alias, or an identifier (FCC id, USB vid:pid, BLE name, chip, SKU). Empty string lists everything.

status.description: Restrict to one effective status (unknown, in-progress, partial-protocol, controllable, open-firmware).

name: search_devices
title: Search the device directory
